paper_compatible_selection_evidence.reason: The active HiGGs SBM evaluation call chain constructs SBMSamplingMetrics and FullSampleMetrics with compute_emd=False. Nodes always use gaussian_tv; the active SBM radius call also keeps its default compute_emd=False. The unused PostProcessSampleMetrics class is not evidence for the reported SBM path.
paper_compatible_selection_evidence.nodes_behavior: SpectreSamplingMetrics always calls compute_mmd with gaussian_tv for Nodes.
paper_compatible_selection_evidence.radius_behavior: The active SBM radius_stats call omits compute_emd, retaining False.
paper_compatible_selection_evidence.excluded_evidence: PostProcessSampleMetrics hard-codes compute_emd=True but has no active repository call site and therefore does not select the paper mode.

common.histogram_normalization: Each histogram is normalized by sum + 1e-6 inside the project's compute_mmd implementation.
common.parallelism: is_parallel=True, using the project's ThreadPoolExecutor paths. radius_stats must use this path because its serial branch does not implement the same shortest-path histogram.

Nodes.histogram: one aggregate np.bincount histogram per graph set

Eccentricity.histogram: 50-bin histogram of all-pairs shortest-path lengths, including zero self-distances, after radius_worker selects the largest connected component

Spectre.histogram: 200-bin normalized-Laplacian eigenvalue histogram over range=(-1e-5, 2) with n_eigvals=-1
